findings.label: Stale job detection uses started_at
findings.description: If a job crashes before setting started_at, it will never be detected as stale. Unlikely in practice but a gap if startup exceptions occur.

findings.label: Retry increment not bounded per-job
findings.description: max_attempts is checked before retry but attempt increments without an upper bound check in the re-queue block. Safe because the query filter prevents re-queuing, but the invariant is not enforced in code.

findings.label: No monitoring of stale running jobs after max_attempts
findings.description: Jobs that exceed max_attempts and remain in running state will never be retried and are invisible unless explicitly queried. They should either fail automatically or be logged with higher visibility.
